 The Internal Revenue Service finalized rules for a provision of the SECURE 2.0 Act providing automatic enrollment in 401(k) and 403(b) retirement plans.

 IRS finalizes rules for 401(k), 403(b) automatic enrollment 
 The IRS and the Treasury released final regulations for a provision of the SECURE 2.0 Act providing automatic enrollment in 401(k) and 403(b) retirement plans.

 ChatGPT will now be able to buy things for a user without having to access the specific card details, provided AI agents can interact with the seller's platform.
